meta.title: Recreate Order from the RFQ stage of a closed eRFX RFQ project
gaps: Verify that every original product is copied with identical product identities and settings; only the resulting line-item count can be asserted.
Verify that the recreated event has exactly the same participants and all original event settings.
Record and assert whether the recreated eRFX stage becomes a single-stage event or a new project as a distinct outcome.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every original product is copied with identical product identities and settings; only the resulting line-item count can be asserted.; Verify that the recreated event has exactly the same participants and all original event settings.; Record and assert whether the recreated eRFX stage becomes a single-stage event or a new project as a distinct outcome.

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ event on its summary page.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify the recreate-order dialog exposes the expected confirmation action.
Confirm recreation using the default values.
Verify that the recreated order reaches a create screen.
Verify that the recreated order contains the prepared event's one copied line item.
Capture the resulting screen so the actual event structure and visible copied configuration can be recorded.
Assert that the recreated result renders without errors, raw identifiers, or a page crash.
